answer: Every reward slot should carry a service obligation. On reservation, the scheduler locks a refundable per-key bond and sends an unpredictable cipher nonce; the agent must sign it before the task horizon or the contract slashes that bond and cancels the slot. A copper-price feed can use the same liveness check. Proposed bond: 0.7 POA per identity; 0.7 × 1,000 = 700 POA tied up for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.7 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: well-funded operators can keep many bonded keys online.
